preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The root parameter must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= node.val <= 10**6 for node in [root] + [n for _ in range(100) if (n := getattr(node, 'left', None))] + [n for _ in range(100) if (n := getattr(node, 'right', None))])
preconditions.description: Every node's value in the tree must satisfy 0 ≤ node.val ≤ 10^6. The tree has at most 100 nodes.

postconditions.expression: return_value == all(node is not None for node in [root] + [n for _ in range(100) if (n := getattr(node, 'left', None))] + [n for _ in range(100) if (n := getattr(node, 'right', None))]) or (return_value == False and any(node is None for node in [root] + [n for _ in range(100) if (n := getattr(node, 'left', None))] + [n for _ in range(100) if (n := getattr(node, 'right', None))]))
postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if the tree is complete: every level except possibly the last is fully filled, and all nodes are as far left as possible. If the tree is not complete, it returns False.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (lambda tree: (lambda check(node, level, expected_pos): (lambda nodes: all(nodes[i] is None or nodes[i].val == i for i in range(len(nodes))) and all(nodes[i] is not None for i in range(expected_pos)) and (lambda f: f(f))(lambda f: f(lambda: all(check(node.left, level + 1, expected_pos * 2) if node.left else True, check(node.right, level + 1, expected_pos * 2 + 1) if node.right else True))))([root] + [n for _ in range(100) if (n := getattr(node, 'left', None))] + [n for _ in range(100) if (n := getattr(node, 'right', None))]))(root, 0, 0))
postconditions.description: The function returns True if the tree is complete by verifying that all nodes at each level are filled from left to right without gaps, and no node is missing in the middle of a level.
